overall_goal: Drink water, tidy the bread box, and clean hands

goals.description: Pour and drink a glass of water
goals.rationale: The person pours water from a jug into a glass, drinks it, and sets the glass down.

goals.description: Store items in the bread box
goals.rationale: The person places medicine and a bag of bagels into the bread box, opening and closing it as needed.
The person claps their hands over the sink to remove stuck mixture and wipes them with a towel.
